name: softwaredlc
description: (Beta) Safely inspect and author SoftwareDLC graph proposals in an explicitly bound local AI worktree.

hosted_origin.title: SoftwareDLC hosted origin
hosted_origin.description: HTTPS origin of the SoftwareDLC app for the login-required hosted connector. Defaults to production; set https://localhost:3000 for local development. To use only the local sdlc-worktree server, turn softwaredlc-hosted off in /mcp.
